title: Recording: Famous Groupies by Wings | 1977
content:
Fair Carol, St John, US Virgin Islands
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Mark Vigars

Wings began recording the London Town song ‘Famous Groupies’ on 13 May 1977.

The session took place aboard the Fair Carol, a 105-foot yacht kitted out with studio equipment from the Record Plant in New York. It was moored in Waterlemon Bay, St John, in the US Virgin Islands.

The backing track had Paul McCartney on acoustic guitar and guide vocals, Jimmy McCulloch on electric guitar, Denny Laine on bass guitar, Linda McCartney on synthesizer, and Joe English on drums.

Although precise numbers of takes are not known, the song was completed relatively quickly and required just one tape reel.
